Respect is more than just a word to us. It's part of who we are. We respect the environment and those Bahamian professionals whose job it is to protect it for future generations through public input, proven scientific research methods, rigorous reporting standards, and transparent evaluation processes. Before work begins at Rosewood Exuma, the team is listening to Sampson Cay.  This week, specialists are walking across the island and recording the natural soundscape of the cay, from the wind and rain to the movement of trees and the unique sounds found in different areas of the island.  These sound readings help establish a clear understanding of the current environment before development begins. As Rosewood Exuma is planned, future systems such as power infrastructure are being carefully assessed to ensure they do not disrupt the natural character and beauty of the Exumas. We are excited to share the next milestone of our journey at Sampson Cay! Over the coming weeks, our teams are moving forward with early site preparation, laying down the physical foundation today for the economic foundations of tomorrow.  Our team is managing the transport of 1,500 cubic yards of local limestone from Black Point, Exuma. At the Yntegra Group, we believe that sustainable hospitality in The Bahamas means building for people. It's an ecosystem rooted in science, environmental responsibility, and local knowledge. This is why we are proud to work hand-in-hand with respected Bahamian professionals who understand and value the delicate balance between progress and preservation. In Valin's own words, "Soil health and plant life are the foundation of healthy ecosystems." True sustainability means choosing Bahamian brilliance to lead the way.  #YntegraGroup #SampsonCayProject #RosewoodExuma #Environment #TheBahamas #ESS #ValinBodie
